headline: Seattle Pacific and Western Washington keep perfect records
dek: Seattle Pacific have won all four they have played and scored eleven doing it, and Western Washington have matched them win for win. Northwest Nazarene's first victory, at Menlo, keeps them unbeaten too.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Saint Martin's twelve goals are more than Northwest Nazarene and Simon Fraser have scored together.

wire.line: Western Washington have won four times and conceded four goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches whose dates have passed carry no result, and every one of them is a Simon Fraser home match from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Western Oregon have conceded exactly as many goals as they have scored, nine of each.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Archie Dhima, a freshman forward, has four goals from ten shots for Western Oregon.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Connor Leistiko has two shutouts for Saint Martin's and has conceded five goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Northwest Nazarene have drawn three times, more draws than any other programme in the conference.

last_match.line: Western Washington's first clean sheet of the season, having conceded in every win before it.

next_match.line: Seattle Pacific have yet to drop a point, and this is their first match away from home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
